science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: Kaio's brass sextant hummed violently as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea threatened to rip the freshly acquired telemetry baton from his grip. The dizzying kaleidoscope of cyan sparks illuminated the chaotic expanse, casting erratic shadows across the rusted iron bulkheads, while the relentless roaring crash of metallic waves drowned out his ragged breathing. The sharp scent of ionized ozone stung his nostrils, the biting chill of the magnetic gale bit through his thermal layers, and a heavy static tang coated his tongue like chewed foil. Wrestling against the overwhelming vortex, he sprinted past the volatile power coupling, using its interference to shield his approach, and finally shoved the baton squarely into Ryn's calloused hands, completing the perilous transfer.
